# مصنع تاج | TAJ Factory — Basyoun, Egypt

> مصنع تاج هو مصنع مصري في بسيون (محافظة الغربية) متخصص في تصنيع ساعات الحائط الفاخرة وتحف الديكور والبوتات والأصص السيراميك. البيع من المصنع مباشرة، والشحن لكل محافظات مصر، والدفع عند الاستلام.

## Facts

- Name: مصنع تاج (TAJ)
- Type: Home goods factory / wall clocks and décor manufacturer
- City: Basyoun, Gharbia Governorate, Egypt
- Coordinates: 31.013279, 30.8531894
- Hours: Daily 10:00–22:00
- Payment: Cash on delivery (الدفع عند الاستلام)
- Shipping: All 27 Egyptian governorates
- Prices: Shown only in the catalog at /catalog — not on the homepage gallery
- Orders: WhatsApp 01010841285

## Products

1. Wall clocks (ساعات حائط): deer clocks, pendulum clocks, kitchen clocks, mirror sun/heart clocks, kids clocks.
2. Décor and pots (تحف وديكور): ceramic pots, planters, incense burners, acrylic luxury pots.

## How to order

1. Choose a piece from the gallery or catalog.
2. Message WhatsApp 01010841285 with product name, size, and city.
3. Confirm details with the factory.
4. Receive at the door and pay on delivery.

## FAQ

- Where is TAJ factory? Basyoun, Gharbia, Egypt.
- Do you ship nationwide? Yes, all Egyptian governorates.
- Cash on delivery? Yes.
- Where are prices? https://tag-eg.online/catalog
- Language: Arabic (Egypt).
